name: adc-approval-usage
description: How to use the ADC approval and ticket capability correctly: how to find the capability you need, in what order to call things, what is intentionally unavailable, and how to read the results. Use when a task needs approval submission, whitelist requests, workflow follow-up or ticket forensics inside the ADC zone. Boundary: this skill only explains tool usage and performs no actions itself. Approval submission is open and every write needs a two-phase confirmation; ticket forensics is read-only. It never makes approval decisions and never widens the scope.
